name: Qwen3.5 9B FP8-dynamic with its own MTP head on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.variant: 9B FP8-dynamic (compressed-tensors, per-channel FP8 weights, dynamic activations) with the publisher's MTP head
library.summary: RedHatAI's FP8-dynamic Qwen3.5-9B served by vLLM XPU on one B70 through the lab's published R276 image and the Qwen3.8 FP8 recipe's strict launchers, with the model's own MTP head as a lossless speculative draft (qwen3_5_mtp) and full decode-only XPU graph capture.
library.quantization: FP8-dynamic (compressed-tensors, per-channel FP8 weights, dynamic activations)

featured_metric.label: MTP depth 3 decode, one card, strict completions suite (center of two fresh servers, 76.917 / 76.879)
featured_metric.scope: Center of two fresh-server class-balanced medians (76.917 / 76.879) over the strict fixed 12-prompt six-class suite through the completions API, 512-token cap, separate empty compile caches, 12/12 complete token arrays exact versus a same-configuration MTP0 oracle (50.183 / 50.150), canaries on every server, cache zero; one B70, R276 image, qwen3_5_mtp depth 3, full decode-only XPU graph capture.

library.benchmark_status: Candidate (2026-09-07, campaign c1, one B70, R276 image): two fresh depth-3 servers 76.917 / 76.879 tok/s class-balanced median over tokens 1-100 on the strict 12-prompt completions suite (512-token cap, cache zero, canaries on every server), 12/12 vs each other and 12/12 vs the MTP0 oracle; two MTP0 servers 50.183 / 50.150 matched 12/12. Identity ladders (128 tokens, two passes): depth 3 exact through c8 (463 tok/s), c16 15/16 (636), c32 28/32 (804), c64 59/64 (745); MTP0 exact through c4, c64 58/64 at 1254 tok/s aggregate. Chat-mode workload with visible thinking measures 105.3 tok/s on the same prompts (workload note, not the headline). Further matrix rows (depth 4, graph off, two cards, 2K-32K) pending.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Lane composition on the existing deterministic vLLM XPU stack (R276 image, lab GDN kernels, strict launchers), speculative depth and capture sweeps, identity gates and ladders, packaging.
contributors.validated_effect: MTP depth 3 with XPU graph capture raised one-card decode from 50.2 (no speculation) to 76.9 tok/s on the strict completions suite, 12/12 exact against the MTP0 oracle on two fresh servers (campaign c1, 2026-09-07).

contributors.name: RedHatAI
contributors.contribution: FP8-dynamic quantization of Qwen3.5-9B and the MTP head checkpoint served here unchanged.
contributors.validated_effect: The published tensors serve as-is through vLLM's compressed-tensors path; the MTP head yields 3-token drafts that the FP8 target verifies losslessly.

performance_profiles.label: Qwen3.5-9B FP8 one card, MTP depth 3 with XPU graph capture, identity-qualified aggregate decode vs concurrent users (c1-c8; warm pass)
performance_profiles.scope: Campaign c1 (2026-09-07): one B70, R276 image, strict launcher env, FULL_DECODE_ONLY capture sizes 1-64, qwen3_5_mtp depth 3, max-model-len 256, max-num-seqs 64, max-num-batched-tokens 512, 128 returned raw token IDs per response on the small-context suite, two passes on one server, warm pass shown. c1-c8 output-identity-qualified in both passes. Measured but withheld: c16 636.3 (15/16), c32 804.4 (28/32), c64 744.6 (59/64).

performance_profiles.label: Qwen3.5-9B FP8 one card, no speculation, XPU graph capture, identity-qualified aggregate decode vs concurrent users (c1-c4; warm pass)
performance_profiles.scope: As above without speculation. c1-c4 output-identity-qualified in both passes. Measured but withheld: c8 354.8 (7/8 warm, 8/8 first pass), c16 634.1 (15/16), c32 1055.0 (30/32), c64 1254.3 (58/64).

model.note: Served exactly as published; the launcher verifies every LFS file against the manifest before the container starts.

runtime.engine: vLLM 0.27.2rc1.dev77+gac7509e2b (XPU) with the lab kernel library (vllm-xpu-kernels 1e90ffa6 + patches, oneDNN 0e2a5bfe + patches)

project_patches.note: The image is the Qwen3.8 INT4 lane's R276 image; its overlays (determinism pad op inert here, FP16 row-chunk linears, grouped GDN speculative rows, draft-head fallback unused, sync-free GDN grouping) ship inside the container. No 9B-specific patch.
